thread:
Elena: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring pattern: rapid prefix population after releases leaves a warmup gap, causing burst cache misses and fallback to cold model variants. Need a compact runbook section: quick triage, exact commands, and a phone-tree escalation.

Marcus: I'll own the runbook patch. Plan: a one-paragraph Quick Triage and a 6-step checklist with pasteable commands. Assign Marcus: runbook PR + smoke test in dev cluster.

Isha: Add a diagnostic one-liner for eviction and cold-hit rate that oncall can paste. Example I used: 

Isha: ```
# eviction rate and cold hits (10m)
curl -s "https://prom.redwood/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total[10m])" | jq . && curl -s "https://prom.redwood/api/v1/query?query=rate(model_cold_loads[10m])" | jq .
```

PagerBot: Postmortem file linked: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/prefix-warmup-gap-206700 (sha: z9y8x7).

Ravi: For mitigations add two reversible steps: 1) route to warm variant; 2) temporarily increase per-node cache quota. Give exact commands and rollback for both.

Dana: Also include a short "when to escalate" box: if eviction_rate per node > 0.05 for 10m OR warm_variant pin fails to restore p95 within 5m -> page eng-sre, then platform. Include pager tags and an after-hours phone tree.

Marcus: Draft mitigation commands for runbook: 

Marcus: ```
# pin warm variant
redwoodctl routes update --route inference-main --model model-stable-warm --force
# increase cache quota (best-effort)
kubectl -n infra patch cm cache-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"per_node_cache_mb":"32768"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deploy/cache-service
# rollback route
redwoodctl routes update --route inference-main --model model-stable --reason "rollback"
```

Isha: I'll add the Prometheus queries and a small helper script that formats the outputs. Will add unit test. Due 72h.

Marcus: Owners & deadlines:
- Marcus: runbook PR with Quick Triage + commands + rollback  due 48h.
- Isha: diagnostic script + unit test  due 72h.
- Dana: escalation phone tree + pager tags in header  due 48h.
- Ravi: validate mitigation cost/latency note and add numbers to runbook  due 72h.

Ravi: I'll add a small table: expected p95 delta (~+30ms) and cost delta estimate.

Marcus: I'll open the PR and tag reviewers @Isha @Dana @Ravi. Please add links here when done so postmortem follow-ups can be closed.

Elena: Thanks — short, testable runbook updates will help avoid repeat incidents. :white_check_mark:
